description: D26: the theme follows the system accent colour live. With the accent seam pinned to the default blue, Settings' primary button and checked switch are blue; loading an orange accent while Settings is open re-themes the same window in place, and both controls take the orange accent (adjusted only where AA requires), in light and dark.
requirement: D26 (native macOS 27 look: live system accent)
notes: Automation builds read the accent from the `accent` fixture when one is loaded (a stand-in for NSColor.controlAccentColor and NSSystemColorsDidChangeNotification); release builds read only the live system value (theme/accent.rs). Loading the fixture runs the same re-theme path the system notification does.

Expected colours are the derivation's output (theme/accent.rs, unit-tested): blue #007aff gives a #0072ef button fill (white text needs 4.5:1) and a #007aff switch. Orange #f7821b: white text fails AA and darkening within the bound does not reach it, so the button keeps the orange fill with black text (as macOS does for light accents); the switch is darkened to #eb7208 to reach 3:1 on the white card, and is #f7821b on the dark card.

appearance.primary and appearance.button_primary are the live theme's colours (cx.theme(), #rrggbb), so the re-theme itself is checked even where the pixel steps are ENV-BLOCKED; appearance.accent_refreshes counts accent re-themes. post_colors_changed (automation only) posts NSSystemColorsDidChangeNotification in-process, so the real observer -> shell inbox -> theme::refresh_accent path runs; it re-reads the loaded fixture, so the colours stay blue and the counter proves the path.
appearance.accent is the accent the theme was built from, as #rrggbb.
Pixel and screenshot steps need Screen Recording: ENV-BLOCKED without it, never a FAIL.

steps.name: the setup's accent fixture ran one re-theme
post NSSystemColorsDidChangeNotification, as AppKit does on an accent change
the observer -> inbox -> re-theme path ran once more
switch the accent to orange while Settings is open
orange/light: the theme took the new accent
orange/light: primary button takes the accent (black text: white fails AA on orange)
orange/light: checked switch takes the accent, darkened to 3:1 on the white card
